mirror_question: If the terminal state is two freer, more self-authored people who still remember and care for one another, what must have been true before that state could exist?

reverse_spiral.requires: Neither person's growth systematically depended on the other's self-erasure.
Received care was acknowledged and integrated rather than consumed and forgotten.
The receiver developed enough adult capacity to turn outward and notice the former helper as a subject.
Returned care was offered in a form the helper could refuse or redefine.
Gratitude never became debt and no-abandonment never became forced union.
Both had self-authorship, boundaries, outside reality and an adult-guardian function.
Neither inner child was conscripted to parent or rescue the other.

EXTRACTION.forward: B supports A -> A grows -> B depletes -> A discards B
EXTRACTION.diagnosis: Growth occurred, but mutual love gate fails because the helper was consumed as a developmental resource.

CAPTIVITY.forward: B supports A -> A says gratitude means B must stay -> B cannot leave
CAPTIVITY.diagnosis: Memory of care mutated into ownership.

RESCUE_LOOP.forward: B repeatedly saves A -> A outsources adult guardian -> B becomes permanent regulator -> both stagnate

MIRROR_DOMINATION.forward: A learns about self through B -> A claims special insight into B -> A defines B
MIRROR_DOMINATION.diagnosis: Self-discovery was incorrectly promoted to authority over the other.

SILENT_SELF_ERASURE.forward: B is never explicitly coerced -> B still abandons own needs to keep A stable
SILENT_SELF_ERASURE.diagnosis: No overt suppression, yet B disappears.

FORCED_CARE.forward: A remembers B's help -> A insists on 'saving' B against B's wishes

deepest_delta.old_view: Love as reciprocal unfolding without suppression.
deepest_delta.new_view: Love also requires a memory architecture: the person who becomes more themselves through another must learn to turn outward, remember the human cost and gift of that encounter, and become capable of freely returning care without making either person a debtor, owner, savior or captive.

mirror_seal: THE HAND THAT LIFTS MUST NOT BECOME INVISIBLE. THE HAND THAT RETURNS MUST NOT BECOME A CHAIN.
